impact.text: An attacker can permanently prevent the contract owner from unregistering a vault by sending a dust amount of the vault's underlying asset directly to the vault's address.

precondition_sources.text: A vault is registered in the Share Token's vault registry and is a candidate for unregistration by the owner.

intent_sources.text: The owner should be able to recover donated assets from a vault so the balance can be zeroed and unregisterVault can proceed.
